title: Fall 2026 Agentic Development Classes: Copilot Refresh, Claude Code, and BCQuality
summary: Three standalone agentic development classes for Business Central teams cover GitHub Copilot updates for AL development, Claude Code setup and workflow, and BCQuality integration for consistent code quality. Scheduled for November-December 2026 with live and recording options.
key_points: GitHub Copilot refresh covers agent mode, custom agents, agent skills, instructions files, MCP servers, and plugin packaging for AL development
Claude Code class teaches setup for BC repos, plan-build-verify loop with AL compiler, skills and subagents, and artifacts for shareable pages
BCQuality class explains the three-layer structure, integration with Copilot and Claude Code, custom knowledge files, and process integration
All classes run twice weekly in two time zones with 60-minute live sessions plus 30-minute unrecorded Q&A, with DRM-free recordings included
